content.comment_body: Hello, I want to control three outputs based on an analog value, according to the table below. The analog input reflects my solar panel’s production, and I plan to adjust my electric water heater in seven steps accordingly. Does anyone have a good idea about how to implement this in [product_name]? / [user_name] Q1 Q2 Q3 Analog in 1 0 0 1 0 1 0 2 1 1 0 3 0 0 1 4 1 0 1 5 0 1 1 6 1 1 1 7
Check the attached file. Please look at: Tools > Parameter VM Mapping
Thank you! That was a fast and simple solution I hadn’t noticed.
Has your issue been resolved now?

Hello. My appreciation for you, [user_name]. Previously, on "10/3/2015 16:08 [product_name]: decimal to binary conversion," you solved something similar. My question is: How can I reach this solution using VM Mapping? I’ve searched, but couldn't find much documentation or literature on this topic.
